questions.question: Which Kushana ruler was famous in history as a great patron of Buddhism and organised the fourth Buddhist Council?
questions.questionHtml: Which Kushana ruler was famous in history as a great patron of Buddhism and organised the fourth Buddhist Council?
questions.solution: Kushana rulers were known for their patronage of Buddhism and their contribution to the spread of the religion in Central Asia and India. The fourth Buddhist Council was held in Kashmir during the reign of Kanishka, which was attended by Buddhist scholars and monks from across the region.

questions.solution:
Distance = relative speed × time ⇒ 500 = (10 + 6) × time ⇒ Time = 500/16 = 125/4 = 31.25 sec

Distance covered by P = 6 × 31.25 = 187.5 m. Distance covered by Q = 10 × 31.25 = 312.5 m

If speeds of P and Q are exchanged then

Time taken by P to cover 312.5 m = 312.5/10 = 31.25 sec. Time taken by Q to cover 187.5 m = 187.5/6 = 31.25 sec

questions.solution: Area of square = total surface area of the cuboid ⇒ (Side)2 =  2 × {(4 × 6) + (6 × 8) + (8 × 4)} ⇒ Side = √208 = 14.42 units2

questions.question: A thief steals an item and escapes, running at a speed of 15 km/h. A policeman arrives at the spot of the crime after 4 minutes and immediately starts chasing the thief. 16 minutes after the policeman started to chase the thief; there is still a gap of 200 m between the two. At what distance from the spot of the crime will the policeman catch up the thief and what is the speed (in km/h) of the policeman?
questions.questionHtml: A thief steals an item and escapes, running at a speed of 15 km/h. A policeman arrives at the spot of the crime after 4 minutes and immediately starts chasing the thief. 16 minutes after the policeman started to chase the thief; there is still a gap of 200 m between the two. At what distance from the spot of the crime will the policeman catch up the thief and what is the speed (in km/h) of the policeman?
questions.solution:
Distance covered by thief in 20 minutes = 15 × (20/60) = 5 km

Distance covered by a policeman in 16 minutes = 4.8 km ⇒ Speed of policeman × (16/60) = 4.8 ⇒ Speed of policeman = (4.8 × 60)/16 = 18 km/hr

Distance = relative speed × time ⇒ 200 = (18 - 15) × (5/18) × time ⇒ Time = (200 × 18)/(3 × 5) ⇒ Time = 240 sec

Distance covered by thief = (15 × 240)/3600 = 1 km

Total distance covered by thief = 5 + 1 = 6 km

questions.question: If (a + b - c) = 20, and a 2 + b 2 + c 2 = 152, find the value of a 3 + b 3 - c 3 + 3abc.
questions.questionHtml: If (a + b - c) = 20, and a<sup>2</sup>+ b<sup>2 </sup>+ c<sup>2</sup> = 152, find the value of a<sup>3</sup> + b<sup>3</sup> - c<sup>3</sup> + 3abc.
questions.solution:
Let c = 0

⇒ (a + b) = 20 and a2 + b2 = 152

(a + b) = 20

Squaring both sides

⇒ a2 + b2 + 2ab = 400 ⇒ 152 + 2ab = 400 ⇒ 2ab = 400 - 152 = 248 ⇒ ab = 248/2 = 124

a3 + b3 = (a + b)3 - 3ab × (a + b) ⇒ (20)3 - 3 × 124 × 20 ⇒ 8000 - 7440 = 560

questions.question: A 40 - litre mixture contains 25% alcohol and 75% water. If 10 litres of water are added to the mixture, the percentage of alcohol in the new mixture is:
questions.questionHtml: A 40 - litre mixture contains 25% alcohol and 75% water. If 10 litres of water are added to the mixture, the percentage of alcohol in the new mixture is:
questions.solution:
Alcohol present in mixture = 40 × 25% = 10 litres. Water present in mixture = 40 - 10 = 30 litres

New quantity of water = 30 + 10 = 40 litres

Percentage of alcohol in mixture = (10 × 100)/50 = 20%

questions.question: 20 women and 15 men together can complete a work in 6 days. It takes 150 days for a single woman to complete the work. In how many days can a single man complete the work?
questions.questionHtml: 20 women and 15 men together can complete a work in 6 days. It takes 150 days for a single woman to complete the work. In how many days can a single man complete the work?
questions.solution:
(20 W + 15 M) × 6 = W × 150 ⇒​ 20 W + 15 M = W × 25 ⇒​ 20 W + 15 M = 25 W - 20 W ⇒​ M/W = 5/15 = 1/3

Total work =  W × 150 ⇒ 3 × 150 = 450 units

Time taken to complete the work by 1 man = 450/1 = 450 days

(AB)2 = (AC)2 + (BC)2 ⇒ (8 + x)2 = 122 + (4 + x)2 ⇒ 64 + x2 + 16x = 144 + 16 + x2 + 8x ⇒ 64 + 16x = 160 + 8x ⇒ 8x = (160 - 64) ⇒ x = 96/8 = 12

BC = (4 + x) = 4 + 12 = 16 cm

questions.question: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 44?
questions.questionHtml: Which of the following numbers is divisible by 44?
questions.solution:
Number = 54736. Last two digits = 36. 36 is divisible by 4. So the number is divisible by 4.

The sum of digits at odd places = 5 + 7 + 6 = 18. The sum of digits at even places = 4 + 3 = 7 

Difference between the sum of odd places and even = (18 - 7) = 11. 11 is divisible by 11. So the number is divisible by 11.

The number is divisible by 11 and 4. So the number is divisible by 44.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. Stories of dolphins’ saving human lives ________ throughout history.
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

Stories of dolphins’ saving human lives ________ throughout history.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is: "have been told".

Key Points
  • The sentence is in the present perfect tense, indicating that the action started in the past and continues up to the present.
  • Structure: 
  • "Have been told" is the correct form of the present perfect tense for the third person plural subject "stories".
  • The use of "throughout history" also suggests that this action has been ongoing.

Thus, option 3 is the correct answer.

Complete sentence: "Stories of dolphins’ saving human lives have been told throughout history."

Additional Information

 

"Have been said" is grammatically correct but less commonly used in this context.

"Told" is in the past tense and does not fit with the present perfect tense of the sentence.

"Had been said" is in the past perfect tense and does not fit with the present perfect tense of the sentence.

Confusion Points

  •  "Told" is used here because it implies the act of narrating or recounting stories.
  • "Said," on the other hand, is more typically used for direct speech or when you want to attribute specific words to a person.
  • Therefore,  "told" is the preferred verb because it relates to the act of narrating stories.
